verses.original: γὰρ Αὐτοὶ οἴδατε ἀδελφοί ὅτι ἡμῶν τὴν εἴσοδον τὴν πρὸς ὑμᾶς γέγονεν οὐ κενὴ
verses.transliteration: gar Autoi oidate adelphoi hoti hēmōn tēn eisodon tēn pros hymas gegonen ou kenē
verses.literal: - You yourselves know brothers that our - visit - to you was not in vain

verses.original: καθὼς οἴδατε προπαθόντες καὶ ὑβρισθέντες ἐν Φιλίπποις ἀλλὰ ἐν πολλῷ ἀγῶνι ἐπαρρησιασάμεθα ἐν ἡμῶν τῷ Θεῷ λαλῆσαι πρὸς ὑμᾶς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: kathōs oidate propathontes kai hybristhentes en Philippois alla en pollō agōni eparrēsiasametha en hēmōn tō Theō lalēsai pros hymas to euangelion tou Theou
verses.literal: As you are aware we had already endured suffering and shameful treatment in Philippi But in the face of strong opposition we were bold in our - God to speak to you the gospel - of God

verses.original: γὰρ ἡμῶν Ἡ παράκλησις οὐκ ἐκ πλάνης οὐδὲ ἐξ ἀκαθαρσίας οὐδὲ ἐν δόλῳ
verses.transliteration: gar hēmōn Hē paraklēsis ouk ek planēs oude ex akatharsias oude en dolō
verses.literal: For our - appeal does not arise from deceit [or] - ulterior motives [or] - trickery

verses.original: ἀλλὰ οὕτως λαλοῦμεν καθὼς δεδοκιμάσμεθα ὑπὸ τοῦ Θεοῦ πιστευθῆναι τὸ εὐαγγέλιον οὐχ ὡς ἀρέσκοντες ἀνθρώποις ἀλλὰ Θεῷ τῷ δοκιμάζοντι ἡμῶν τὰς καρδίας
verses.transliteration: alla houtōs laloumen kathōs dedokimasmetha hypo tou Theou pisteuthēnai to euangelion ouch hōs areskontes anthrōpois alla Theō tō dokimazonti hēmōn tas kardias
verses.literal: Instead - we speak as those approved by - God to be entrusted with the gospel not in order to please men but God who examines our - hearts

verses.original: γάρ καθὼς οἴδατε οὔτε ποτε ἐγενήθημεν ἐν λόγῳ κολακείας οὔτε ἐν προφάσει πλεονεξίας Θεὸς μάρτυς
verses.transliteration: gar kathōs oidate oute pote egenēthēmen en logō kolakeias oute en prophasei pleonexias Theos martys
verses.literal: vvv As you know vvv vvv we never used . . . words of flattery [or] - [any] pretext for greed God [is] [our] witness

verses.original: οὔτε ζητοῦντες ἐξ ἀνθρώπων δόξαν οὔτε ἀφ’ ὑμῶν οὔτε ἀπ’ ἄλλων ὡς ἀπόστολοι Χριστοῦ δυνάμενοι εἶναι βάρει ἐν
verses.transliteration: oute zētountes ex anthrōpōn doxan oute aph’ hymōn oute ap’ allōn hōs apostoloi Christou dynamenoi einai barei en
verses.literal: Nor did we seek - - praise - from you [or] from anyone else [although] as apostles of Christ we had authority vvv to demand [it] . . .

verses.original: Ἀλλὰ ἐγενήθημεν ἤπιοι ἐν ὑμῶν μέσῳ ὡς τροφὸς ἐὰν θάλπῃ ἑαυτῆς τὰ τέκνα
verses.transliteration: Alla egenēthēmen ēpioi en hymōn mesō hōs trophos ean thalpē heautēs ta tekna
verses.literal: On the contrary we were gentle among you - like a nursing mother vvv caring for her - children

verses.original: οὕτως ὁμειρόμενοι ὑμῶν εὐδοκοῦμεν μεταδοῦναι ὑμῖν οὐ μόνον τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀλλὰ τὰς ἑαυτῶν ψυχάς καὶ διότι ἀγαπητοὶ ἐγενήθητε ἡμῖν
verses.transliteration: houtōs homeiromenoi hymōn eudokoumen metadounai hymin ou monon to euangelion tou Theou alla tas heautōn psychas kai dioti agapētoi egenēthēte hēmin
verses.literal: vvv We cared so deeply - [that] we were delighted to share with you not only the gospel - of God but our own lives as well That is how beloved you have become to us

verses.original: Μνημονεύετε γάρ ἀδελφοί ἡμῶν τὸν κόπον καὶ τὸν μόχθον ἐργαζόμενοι νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας πρὸς μὴ τὸ ἐπιβαρῆσαί τινα ὑμῶν ἐκηρύξαμεν εἰς ὑμᾶς τὸ εὐαγγέλιον τοῦ Θεοῦ
verses.transliteration: Mnēmoneuete gar adelphoi hēmōn ton kopon kai ton mochthon ergazomenoi nyktos kai hēmeras pros mē to epibarēsai tina hymōn ekēryxamen eis hymas to euangelion tou Theou
verses.literal: Surely you recall . . . brothers our - labor and - toil We worked night and day so that vvv vvv we would not be a burden to anyone - while we proclaimed to you the gospel - of God

verses.original: ὑμεῖς μάρτυρες καὶ ὁ Θεός ὡς ὁσίως καὶ δικαίως καὶ ἀμέμπτως ἐγενήθημεν ὑμῖν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν
verses.transliteration: hymeis martyres kai ho Theos hōs hosiōs kai dikaiōs kai amemptōs egenēthēmen hymin tois pisteuousin
verses.literal: You [are] witnesses and [so is] - God of how holy - righteous and blameless our conduct was among you who believed

verses.original: καθάπερ οἴδατε ὡς ἕκαστον ἕνα ὑμῶν ὡς πατὴρ ἑαυτοῦ τέκνα
verses.transliteration: kathaper oidate hōs hekaston hena hymōn hōs patēr heautou tekna
verses.literal: For you know that [we treated] each - of you as a father [treats] his own children

verses.original: παρακαλοῦντες καὶ παραμυθούμενοι ὑμᾶς καὶ μαρτυρόμενοι εἰς ὑμᾶς τὸ περιπατεῖν ἀξίως τοῦ Θεοῦ τοῦ καλοῦντος ὑμᾶς εἰς ἑαυτοῦ τὴν βασιλείαν καὶ δόξαν
verses.transliteration: parakalountes kai paramythoumenoi hymas kai martyromenoi eis hymas to peripatein axiōs tou Theou tou kalountos hymas eis heautou tēn basileian kai doxan
verses.literal: encouraging [you] - comforting you and urging - you - to walk in a manner worthy - of God who calls you into His own - kingdom and glory

verses.original: Καὶ καὶ ἡμεῖς ἀδιαλείπτως εὐχαριστοῦμεν τῷ Θεῷ ὅτι διὰ τοῦτο παραλαβόντες λόγον τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀκοῆς παρ’ ἡμῶν ἐδέξασθε οὐ λόγον ἀνθρώπων ἀλλὰ καθὼς ἀληθῶς ἐστὶν λόγον Θεοῦ ὃς καὶ ἐνεργεῖται ἐν ὑμῖν τοῖς πιστεύουσιν
verses.transliteration: Kai kai hēmeis adialeiptōs eucharistoumen tō Theō hoti dia touto paralabontes logon tou Theou akoēs par’ hēmōn edexasthe ou logon anthrōpōn alla kathōs alēthōs estin logon Theou hos kai energeitai en hymin tois pisteuousin
verses.literal: And . . . we continually thank - God - because - when you received [the] word - of God that you heard from us you accepted [it] not [as the] word of men but as it truly is . . . [the] word of God which is also [now] at work in you who believe

verses.original: γὰρ Ὑμεῖς ἀδελφοί ἐγενήθητε μιμηταὶ τῶν ἐκκλησιῶν τοῦ Θεοῦ ἐν τῇ Ἰουδαίᾳ τῶν οὐσῶν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ ὅτι ὑμεῖς καὶ ἐπάθετε ὑπὸ τῶν ἰδίων συμφυλετῶν τὰ αὐτὰ καθὼς αὐτοὶ καὶ ὑπὸ τῶν Ἰουδαίων
verses.transliteration: gar Hymeis adelphoi egenēthēte mimētai tōn ekklēsiōn tou Theou en tē Ioudaia tōn ousōn en Christō Iēsou hoti hymeis kai epathete hypo tōn idiōn symphyletōn ta auta kathōs autoi kai hypo tōn Ioudaiōn
verses.literal: For you brothers became imitators of the churches - of God in - Judea that are in Christ Jesus - You - suffered from [your] own countrymen the very things - - they [suffered] from the Jews

verses.original: τῶν ἀποκτεινάντων καὶ τὸν Κύριον Ἰησοῦν καὶ τοὺς προφήτας καὶ ἐκδιωξάντων ἡμᾶς καὶ μὴ ἀρεσκόντων Θεῷ καὶ ἐναντίων πᾶσιν ἀνθρώποις
verses.transliteration: tōn apokteinantōn kai ton Kyrion Iēsoun kai tous prophētas kai ekdiōxantōn hēmas kai mē areskontōn Theō kai enantiōn pasin anthrōpois
verses.literal: who killed both the Lord Jesus and their own prophets and drove us out {as well} . . . - vvv They are displeasing to God and hostile to all men

verses.original: κωλυόντων ἡμᾶς λαλῆσαι τοῖς ἔθνεσιν ἵνα σωθῶσιν εἰς πάντοτε τὸ ἀναπληρῶσαι αὐτῶν τὰς ἁμαρτίας δὲ εἰς τέλος ἡ ὀργὴ ἔφθασεν ἐπ’ αὐτοὺς
verses.transliteration: kōlyontōn hēmas lalēsai tois ethnesin hina sōthōsin eis pantote to anaplērōsai autōn tas hamartias de eis telos hē orgē ephthasen ep’ autous
verses.literal: hindering us from telling the Gentiles how they may be saved As a result {they} continue - to heap up their - sins {to full capacity} - the utmost - wrath has come upon them

verses.original: ἀδελφοί δέ Ἡμεῖς ἀπορφανισθέντες ἀφ’ ὑμῶν πρὸς καιρὸν ὥρας προσώπῳ οὐ καρδίᾳ ἐν πολλῇ ἐπιθυμίᾳ ἰδεῖν ὑμῶν τὸ πρόσωπον περισσοτέρως ἐσπουδάσαμεν
verses.transliteration: adelphoi de Hēmeis aporphanisthentes aph’ hymōn pros kairon hōras prosōpō ou kardia en pollē epithymia idein hymōn to prosōpon perissoterōs espoudasamen
verses.literal: Brothers although we were torn away from you for a short time . . . (in person not in heart) [our] - desire to see you - face [to face] vvv was even more intense

verses.original: διότι ἠθελήσαμεν ἐλθεῖν πρὸς ὑμᾶς μὲν ἐγὼ Παῦλος καὶ ἅπαξ καὶ δίς καὶ ὁ Σατανᾶς ἐνέκοψεν ἡμᾶς
verses.transliteration: dioti ēthelēsamen elthein pros hymas men egō Paulos kai hapax kai dis kai ho Satanas enekopsen hēmas
verses.literal: For we wanted to come to you indeed I Paul [tried] again and again but - Satan obstructed us

verses.original: γὰρ τίς ἡμῶν ἐλπὶς ἢ χαρὰ ἢ στέφανος καυχήσεως ἢ οὐχὶ καὶ ὑμεῖς ἔμπροσθεν ἡμῶν τοῦ Κυρίου Ἰησοῦ ἐν αὐτοῦ τῇ παρουσίᾳ
verses.transliteration: gar tis hēmōn elpis ē chara ē stephanos kauchēseōs ē ouchi kai hymeis emprosthen hēmōn tou Kyriou Iēsou en autou tē parousia
verses.literal: After all who [is] our hope [our] joy [our] crown of boasting if it is not - you yourselves in the presence of our - Lord Jesus at His - coming

verses.original: ὑμεῖς ἐστε γάρ ἡμῶν ἡ δόξα καὶ ἡ χαρά
verses.transliteration: hymeis este gar hēmōn hē doxa kai hē chara
verses.literal: You are indeed our - glory and [our] joy
